## Integration target
Framework, platform, editor, CI system, browser, agent framework, or other tool.

## Desired developer experience
Show the smallest API or workflow you want a developer to use.

## AML capability needed
Examples: Interface Firewall, View Meaning, Meaning Gate, receipts, policy profiles, semantic diff, LSP.

## Compatibility constraints
Runtime/version/security limitations we should respect.

## Success test
What runnable example or automated test would prove the integration works?
